sources.title: aisingapore/Gemma-SEA-LION-v4-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Gemma-SEA-LION-v4-27B is based on Gemma 3 (which supports over 100 languages) and is a multilingual model which has undergone continued pre-training on approximately 500B tokens sampled from a bucket of over one trillion tokens across 11 SEA languages: Burmese, English, Indonesian, Khmer, Lao, Malay, Mandarin, Tagalog, Tamil, Thai and Vietnamese.

sources.title: aisingapore/Gemma-SEA-LION-v4-27B-IT · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: As of 25 Aug 2025, Gemma-SEA-LION-v4-27B-IT excels at Southeast Asian (SEA) tasks when compared to other open models with fewer than 200 billion parameters and demonstrates performance comparable to that of larger and top closed models.
